subject.title: [Bug]: Embedded runner "Network connection lost" when LLM generates a tool call with large parameters (param generation latency > underlying request timeout)

question: Which policy should OpenClaw use for OpenRouter-routed Anthropic models that stay silent while generating large tool-call arguments?
rationale: The source confirms the remaining failure mode is plausible, but the available fixes trade off default stall detection latency, provider-specific behavior, and large tool-payload semantics.

options.title: Keep canonical and require live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-sponsored fix includes synthetic stream-silence regression coverage and a redacted live OpenRouter Anthropic proof.

options.title: Timeout-policy mitigation
options.body: Document or change timeout defaults for affected cloud/provider routes, accepting slower detection of genuine upstream stalls.

options.title: Provider-streaming direction
options.body: Pursue provider-specific tool-argument streaming where OpenRouter and the upstream model can actually emit argument deltas.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical and require live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-sponsored fix includes synthetic stream-silence regression coverage and a redacted live OpenRouter Anthropic proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current timeout wrapper and adjacent OpenAI/OpenRouter code history most strongly point to this area ownership.
